timer.endpoint_scope: Consumer high-resolution host endpoints determine TPS; parent QPC brackets process/received stderr only.

ready_baseline.definition: Last process-running sample between received ready and earliest actual prefill-begin; null when none exists.

limits: All boundaries are parent receipt times from live stderr, not exact device/allocator times. Phase names are discovered from actual markers, including session prefixes.
Missing/duplicate/reversed boundaries have no derived phase values; short/full-hit phases may have zero samples. Null bytes remain null, never zero-filled.
PSAPI/PDH sampled maxima are lower bounds, not physical allocation totals. Dedicated/shared separate maxima must not be added; total uses simultaneous available counters.
Neighbor-sample phase deltas include bracket age and may include subsequent work or teardown; they do not attribute allocations or frees.
Old runs whose observer dropped session-prefixed markers cannot have timestamped phase samples reconstructed from untimestamped stderr. This adapter does not rewrite them.
Memory sampling is independent and never contributes to unmonitored timing denominators.
hyle_plain.counter_source: Windows PSAPI and PDH GPU Process Memory (WDDM); not direct DXGI allocator enumeration

fixed_workload.model: Qwen3.5-2B BF16 text, matched original weights

quiet_window.source: Root scheduling; measured process/clock/GPU-boundary records archived. B04 Range batch was explicitly paused before the first window and resumed only after both terminal0.

memory_scope.protocol: Original Windows PSAPI/PDH process observer in separate memory-only processes.
memory_scope.GPU_dedicated: WDDM per-process dedicated usage, not exact CUDA allocation accounting.
memory_scope.GPU_shared: Reported system-memory usage; may overlap CPU categories.
memory_scope.GPU_total: Dedicated+shared from the same valid sample; never sum independent category peaks.
memory_scope.CPU_working_set: Resident working set includes mapped/shared pages.
memory_scope.CPU_private_commit: Committed private address space, not resident physical RAM or pagefile disk usage.
memory_scope.phase_bracket_deltas: Neighbor-sample differences with actual ages; not exact phase-boundary allocation deltas.

limits: Each arm has three independent timing processes; report every sample/range, no significance or universal speed claim.
Natural generated tokens and MTP accept/verify work differ across arms. No equal-token or fully equal-arithmetic speed claim.
Two turns keep one resident session/context. Target prefill309 includes one pending flush; new-user308 is separate;126 decode outputs exclude two first-prefill outputs.
Top-level continuous P+D=session covers turn transitions. Nested turn intervals do not replace those endpoints.
MTP extra draft/catchup/verification rows are charged as work, never credited as output/user tokens.
Load endpoint is implementation-defined and excludes OS DLL load before main; last-output endpoint excludes destruction.
Timing is unmonitored;8 independent memory processes do not provide TPS evidence.10ms requested sampling cadence is not exact.
Current source snapshot is not an isolated MMQ or single-change speedup experiment. No historical samples are pooled or used to claim causal gain.
Complete task-quality checks remain separately reported; readable outputs or this finite workload do not establish model quality.
